app "Water" drop ocean
table drink ml num 1..5000 unit "ml"
setting goal num = 2000 "Daily goal (ml)"
let ml = sum(drink.ml )
let p = clamp(ml / goal, 0, 1)
row gap 3
  draw 56, 108 width 56
    rect 8, 104 - 100 * p, 40, 100 * p fill accent
    path "M6 4h44l-6 100H12z" stroke ink thick 2
  stack grow
    text ml "ml" big
    text "Goal" goal "ml" faint tap edit goal
quick drink, ml, [250, 500]
form drink
daybars last 7 days, sum(drink.ml on it)
list drink
app "Cycle" heart plum
table period flow pick Light|Medium|Heavy = Medium
let cyc = round(gap(period))
text "Day" since(period) + 1 "of your cycle" big
text "Next period in about" cyc - - since(period) "days. Average cycle" cyc "days." faint
button "Period started today" tap add period
calendar period
log period
app "Weight" scale mint
table weigh kg num 20..300
setting target num = 70 "Target weight (kg)"
let kg = last(weigh.kg)
text kg "kg" big
text abs(round(kg - target)) "kg to target," round(kg - first(weigh.kg last 30 days)) "kg in 30 days" faint
trend weigh last 90 days sort at, it.kg
form weigh
log weigh
app "Quiz" star plum
table item question text, a text, b text, c text, right pick A|B|C
table answer item ref item, chose pick A|B|C
let score = countof(answer, it.chose = it.item.right)
text score "of" count(answer) "right" big
each item as x
  if count(x.answer) = 0
    stack card gap 1
      text x.question head
      button x.a tap add answer item = x, chose = "A"
      button x.b tap add answer item = x, chose = "B"
      button x.c tap add answer item = x, chose = "C"
each answer as r
    text r.item.question grow
    text if(r.chose = r.item.right, "Right", "Wrong") color if(r.chose = r.item.right, good, bad)
form item, "Add question"
